extracted.intended_audience: writers, students, and critics of short fiction; magazine editors and literary readers
extracted.subtask_description: Criteria and critical principles for selecting and judging American short stories (1917-era), focusing on authorial intent, craft (characterization, atmosphere, economy, unity), and the work's emotional and national significance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accept author's point of view and measure success
rubrics_metrics.description: In selecting them, I have sought to accept the author's point of view and manner of treatment, and to measure simply the degree of success he had in doing what he set out to achieve.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary evaluative stance: judge how well the story accomplishes its own aims rather than forcing an external standard. Examples: stories included because they succeed at the author's chosen manner or intention even if that manner differs from the critic's personal taste.

rubrics_metrics.name: Faithful and imaginative rendering of folk-life
rubrics_metrics.description: Faithful and imaginative rendering of American folk-life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authenticate setting and culture imaginatively; e.g., 'The Excursion' praised for rendering American countryside humor and folk-life with economy. This favors authenticity and imaginative embodiment of regional life.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subtle characterization
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtle characterization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Character development that avoids blunt exposition; often achieved through indirect means. Example: characterization 'achieved almost entirely through dialogue' is cited as a mark of subtlety.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy of means
rubrics_metrics.description: Economy of means.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Achieving effect with minimal, efficient language and scene-setting. Cited approvingly where humor or characterization is revealed with the 'utmost economy of means.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Characterization through dialogue
rubrics_metrics.description: Characterization is achieved almost entirely through dialogue.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use of dialogue as primary vehicle for portraiture; praised when it renders characters 'inimitably in a phrase or two.' Anti-pattern: relying on exposition instead of let characters speak for themselves.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concise vivid portraiture
rubrics_metrics.description: Portraiture of characters rendered inimitably in a phrase or two.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ability to encapsulate a vivid character image briefly. Example: short, memorable phrases that define a person immediately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality / discovery of new talent
rubrics_metrics.description: Originality — discovery of a memorable first story or most original new talent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Novel voice or approach that marks a writer as a significant new presence (e.g., 'memorable first story by a new writer'). Weight given to originality even when it diverges from established models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Convincing conclusion / resolution of character
rubrics_metrics.description: Conclusion and the resolution of character that it involves is artistically convincing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Endings should feel inevitable or artistically justified; the critic praises stories whose conclusions resolve character arcs in a convincing manner ('artistically convincing').

rubrics_metrics.name: Faithful, vivid rendering of life
rubrics_metrics.description: Stark faithfulness which makes obvious material an extremely vivid and freshly felt rendering of life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Truthfulness and vividness of depiction, even of commonplace subject matter. Example: rendering obvious material with vividness and freshness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality of observation
rubrics_metrics.description: A certain quality of observation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keen perceptive detail and observational acuity that bring scenes and characters alive; compared to traits considered Gallic rather than American in one instance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriate restraint and use of suggestion
rubrics_metrics.description: Greater restraint and less cautious use of suggestion would have better answered his purpose.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Know when to suggest rather than state; restraint and implication can strengthen a story. Over- or under-use of suggestion is noted as a stylistic choice with consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compression of emotion / katharsis
rubrics_metrics.description: Compresses the emotion of a Greek drama into a space of perhaps four thousand words; the katharsis is timeless in its final solution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Powerful emotional compression appropriate to short-form length; effective cathartic resolution comparable to dramatic classics is praised.

rubrics_metrics.name: Atmosphere as motive power
rubrics_metrics.description: Atmosphere is realized completely for its own sake, and as a motive power urging the lives of his characters to their inevitable end.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Atmosphere should not be merely background but actively propel characters and action. Example: stories where setting/atmosphere shapes fate of characters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dominant atmosphere over speech
rubrics_metrics.description: Its secret is the secret of atmosphere rather than speech, but atmosphere here becomes human in its reality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize creation of an enveloping atmosphere when appropriate; sometimes atmosphere (mood, environment) is the story's primary vehicle rather than dialogue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dramatic impact and clear message
rubrics_metrics.description: A most dramatic story results with a sure and true message for the American people.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories that achieve dramatic force and convey a clear, resonant message (social, moral, national) are highly valued. Example: wartime stories with a compelling civic or human message.

rubrics_metrics.name: Balance: technique vs. substance
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Burt's technique is still a trifle over-sophisticated ... this is a fault on virtue's side.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical sophistication should not overwhelm substance; over-sophistication can be a minor fault though sometimes acceptable. Evaluate whether technique serves or distracts from effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imaginative realism: elevating simple material
rubrics_metrics.description: Imaginative realism weaves poignant beauty out of the simplest and most dusty elements in life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ability to transform ordinary material into poignant art through imaginative perception (e.g., converting humble details into moving literature).

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity and completeness
rubrics_metrics.description: It certainly has the unity of a well-defined spiritual incident ... viewed as a completely rounded whole.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short stories should possess structural unity and feel complete as an artistic unit, even when approaching novella length.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoidance of sentimentalization; emotional reticence
rubrics_metrics.description: You will not find the slightest sentimentalization of her subject matter ... an increasing reticence in the portrayal of her characters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resist easy sentiment; restraint and controlled tone often strengthen truth and artistry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural dramatic story sense
rubrics_metrics.description: Few American writers have such a natural dramatic story sense.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Innate sense of dramatic shape and timing that suits short fiction; dramatic instincts that serve the short form rather than novelistic habits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incisive, faithful portraiture of personality
rubrics_metrics.description: Faithful rendering of a personality ... rendered with incisive kindliness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Psychologically acute, believable portraits favored; incisive kindness or truthful depiction even when unpleasant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emotional validity and adequacy of handling
rubrics_metrics.description: The emotional validity of her substance is absolutely unimpeachable and her handling of the situation it presents is adequate and fine.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emotional truthfulness and appropriate handling of material—stories must feel emotionally valid and be treated with adequate craft.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integration of character and atmosphere
rubrics_metrics.description: Character merges with atmosphere almost imperceptibly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Successful stories integrate character psychology with the surrounding atmosphere so that the two reinforce each other, producing a seamless effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simplicity and directness where appropriate
rubrics_metrics.description: Woven out of the simplest elements, and with an entire lack of literary sophistication, his story is fairly comparable to the work of Daniel Corkery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Direct, unsophisticated narratives can be powerful; simplicity is an asset when it produces authenticity and clarity rather than sloppiness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification with subject (empathy) rather than condescension
rubrics_metrics.description: Miss Geer's method is the result of identification with, rather than condescension toward, her subject.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Empathic portrayal of subjects (especially of other cultures or social classes) is valued over patronizing distance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legendary / folk-story quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Presented a folk story with a significant legendary quality ... one of the better folk stories of the year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories that achieve mythic or legendary resonance and function as memorable folk narratives are prized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative impulse and shaping of form
rubrics_metrics.description: Captain Greene's natural gift of narrative is the result of a strong impulse toward creative expression, which molds its form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A story should show an organic narrative drive that shapes form and pacing; form should arise from the narrative impulse.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exemplary construction / model for students
rubrics_metrics.description: I regard the story as almost a model of construction for students of short story writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Structural craftsmanship and clear construction that can serve as a teaching model are especially notable; look for well-ordered plots and felicitous scene arrangement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Persuasiveness of exposition and closely woven craftsmanship
rubrics_metrics.description: The persuasiveness of her exposition conceals inimitably the closely woven craftsmanship of her work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exposition should be persuasive and artful, masking the labor of craft; tight, finely-wrought workmanship is a virtue.

rubrics_metrics.name: National significance / distinctive national contribution
rubrics_metrics.description: It is along the lines of his method ... that America is most likely eventually to contribute something distinctively national to the world's literary culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories that help define or point toward a distinctive national literature (national voice or themes) are valued; consider cultural significance beyond immediate artistry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Memorability and promise for future work
rubrics_metrics.description: A memorable first story by a new writer and would of itself be enough to make a reputation ... a promise for a vivid and interesting future.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate whether the story is memorable and indicates future promise for the author; potential for lasting reputation is a positive factor.
